_comment: UI metadata for realign, read by the command-center scanner. Today it carries only the TL;DR at the top of the strategy page: plain-English bullets whose {param} tokens the page fills with that setting's default, and whose show_if hides a bullet once its setting leaves the default. UI ONLY: it never touches a trade decision or the source hash. Click Scan Strategies after editing. Rules: command-center/backend/CLAUDE.md -> The TL;DR.

tldr.text: It waits for the 15-minute trend to flip, betting the flip is a trap; another break the same way cancels the idea.
The trigger: within {realign_window_hrs} hours, the 5-minute chart breaks against the trend, then shifts back with it.
It enters at market on that 5-minute bar's close, aiming for the 15-minute swing that stood before the trap.
The stop sits {realign_sl_buf_tk} ticks past the pullback's extreme; halfway to the target it moves just past breakeven.
Nothing is banked early: at the target the stop lifts, then trails each new swing in {exec_trail_pct}% steps.
A trade short of halfway after {exec_time_stop_hrs} hours is closed; a setup whose stop is under {exec_min_stop_val}% of price is skipped.
Each trade risks {exec_risk_pct}% of the account, sized off its stop distance, and it holds one trade at a time.

params.name: exec_risk_pct
params.label: Risk % per trade
params.desc: How much of the account each trade risks. The stop distance sets the position size, so a tighter stop buys a bigger position at the same risk.
